method: For each in-scope entry, read summaryJa, authorInterpretationJa, and editorialNoteJa, then compare the covered verses with the packet's WEB and KJV primary text and read the complete chapter-level JFB sourceContext.originalText. Judge the five required checks per entry; do not infer a pass from schema validity, quotation matching, or an earlier review. Record a unique, range-specific Japanese reason and bind it to the packet canonicalEntrySha256. Candidate originals were not changed; proposed corrections, if any, belong only in report records.

quarantinedPriorReports.reason: Earlier ECC/SNG reports lacked sufficiently entry-specific evidence of reading all three Japanese fields against the primary WEB/KJV text and full JFB context; they were not eligible for pass. ECC-01–12 and SNG-01–08 were rebuilt only after direct rereading. Quarantined drafts remain excluded from the accepted reports.
